capabilities: render countdown progress bars in code blocks
count up or down to dates and times
customize bar shape, colors, and info text
set plugin-wide defaults and per-block overrides
extras: Docs warn that very low update intervals for many bars can hurt performance; real-time updates are off by default.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to visualize time remaining until a deadline or event inside notes.

relations.evidence: Countdown To is compatible with Obsidian Parameters.
Multiple progress bar styles: Line, Circle, SemiCircle, and Square (from progressbar.js
Flexible date and time formatting using Luxon

summary: Code-block plugin that renders countdown progress bars with customizable shapes, colors, and Luxon date formatting for deadlines and events.
